articles.title: Americans Dying For Israeli Interests? Trump's Ex-Security Chief Joe Kent Slams Iran War | Watch
articles.description: Donald Trump's Iran war is triggering a growing rebellion within his own political camp. Now, his former counterterrorism chief Joe Kent is sounding the alarm, claiming the conflict has already cost American taxpayers more than $47 billion — and demanding that the President bring it to an end. In a blistering attack on X, Kent questions the rationale behind America's military campaign, arguing that Washington is repeating the mistakes of the post-9/11 wars, which he says cost between $8 trillion and $9 trillion without making America safer.
